standard.summary: 每隔多少个优化步检查一次 NaN/Inf loss。默认 1 = 每步检查。
standard.effect: 增大此值可略微降低检查开销，但 NaN 检测延迟相应增加，出现 NaN 后仍会多跑几步。
standard.whenToUse: 保持默认 1 即可。仅在意极致性能时才考虑设为 5~10。
standard.avoidWhen: 不宜设置过大（>50），否则真实 NaN 崩溃会被忽视很多步。

standard_en.summary: How many optimisation steps apart the NaN/Inf loss check runs. Default 1 = every step.
standard_en.effect: Raising it lowers the checking overhead slightly, but NaN detection is delayed by the same amount and a few more steps run after a NaN appears.
standard_en.whenToUse: The default 1 is fine. Only consider 5~10 if you care about absolute performance.
standard_en.avoidWhen: It should not be set too high (>50), or a real NaN collapse goes unnoticed for many steps.

advanced.principle: 每 N 步执行 torch.isnan(loss).any() + torch.isinf(loss).any()，代价约为一次 GPU→CPU 同步（约 0.1ms）。
advanced.expectedImpact: 从 1 改为 10，理论节省约 1-5μs/step（几乎不可测量），不值得为此牺牲检测实时性。

advanced_en.principle: Every N steps it runs torch.isnan(loss).any() + torch.isinf(loss).any(), costing roughly one GPU→CPU sync (about 0.1ms).
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Going from 1 to 10 saves about 1-5μs/step in theory (practically unmeasurable) — not worth sacrificing detection latency for.
